items.title: Palo Alto Networks (PANW) Stock Looks Pricey As Its 5 Year Gain Nears 5x
items.summary: Palo Alto Networks stock has delivered very strong long term gains over the past five years, yet current valuation checks point to the shares trading at a premium to an estimate of intrinsic value based on a Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) approach and to market multiples. The stock has returned roughly 5.2x over 5 years, which sets a high bar for any further upside to be supported by fundamentals.
